prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across both agreeing tests (-15.6% and -8.9%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across all 3 tests (-13.2%, -0.9%, and -4.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 10 of 13 tests, despite 3 winning tests (+6.4%, +3.6%, and +2.7%).
Kinds of changes with only 1 test provide weak evidence and cannot be treated as established patterns until replicated.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Card View Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a card-based comparison layout clearly contrasting companion creation paths. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean time of 514s, showing users hesitate before choosing an onboarding path.)
1: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Compact Layout Focus: Switch the sign-in screen to a streamlined compact layout focused on quick account authentication. (why: Sign-in shows stalling for some users with a mean of 567s and reported sign-in screen glitches in support emails.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Story Scroll Layout Redesign: Redesign the friend selection screen into a story scroll layout highlighting pet animations and traits. (why: Adoption has a 78.8% conversion rate and median time of 89s, indicating selection hesitation.)
3: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Lighting Advice Hint: Add clear guidance text advising users to upload well-lit, clear photos for optimal pet generation quality. (why: Support received multiple reports of custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.)
4: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Split Stage View: Redesign the generation waiting screen into a split stage view displaying generation progress alongside desktop docking tips. (why: The home stage waiting process has a long mean duration (2336s), leading to user drop-off.)
5: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Stage Layout Overview: Redesign the final home welcome screen into a stage layout showing pet interaction controls. (why: Finish conversion drops to 75.5% and support receives emails about confusion over controlling or hiding desktop pets.)
6: [home, notification] Waiting Screen System Tray Notification: Enable desktop background notifications to alert users when their desktop pet is ready to dock. (why: Long wait times (mean 2336s) cause users to switch away; notifications bring them back when ready.)
7: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Interaction Guide Hint: Add explicit instructions on how to right-click or use system tray icons to control, hide, or summon the pet. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion over post-onboarding desktop controls.)
